statement: The rational-cubic count, with intersection multiplicity, is below 12 exactly when three points are collinear or six lie on an irreducible conic. The completed singular-cubic fibre is infinite exactly when four are collinear or seven lie on a conic; then no irreducible cubic exists. There are 779777 quatroid strata (125 relabelling orbits). Each is irreducible except the 840 relabellings of (I,J)=({123,145,167,246,258,357,368,478},empty), whose strata each have two irreducible components.

answer.text: The multiplicity-weighted count drops below 12 exactly on the collinear-triple or conic-sextuple locus; completed infinite fibres and the quatroid strata are classified.
answer.display: Count-drop locus: collinear triple or conic sextuple; infinite completed fibre: four collinear or seven on a conic

scope: Eight labelled distinct points p in complex projective 2-space; irreducible singular cubics, weighted by intersection multiplicity of their cubic pencil with the cubic discriminant. Quatroids specify all collinear triples and irreducible-conic sextuples.
